01
PRODUCTION CAPABILITIES

Good ideas. Made tangible.

From detailed graphics to dimensional stitching, we match the production method to your product, material and market.

01 / DTG
DTG printing

Direct-to-garment printing for photographs, gradients and detailed artwork on cotton and cotton-rich apparel.

T-shirts · Apparel
Machine: SL-DTG-X2S
Explore this technique
02 / EMBROIDERY
Computerised embroidery

Digitised designs and multi-head embroidery bring texture and a distinctive finish to your brand identity.

Caps · Polos · Bags
Equipment: multi-head embroidery
Explore this technique
03 / SUBLIMATION
Sublimation printing

All-over printing bonds colour into polyester fibres for expressive, full-coverage apparel and sportswear.

All-over print · Sportswear
Epson SC-F11030 · heat press PD-1800D-800
Explore this technique
04 / LASER
Laser cutting & engraving

Precision cutting and engraving for personalised gifts and decor in wood, acrylic, leather and fabric.

Decor · Personalised gifts
Laser FW-1822 · auto cutter LP-2219
Explore this technique

FROM FILE TO FINISHED

Your next collection starts here.

A clear process, with people alongside you at every handoff.

ONOS / DEVELOPMENT
Product development starts with a conversation.
01
Share the idea

Tell us your product, expected volume and destination. We recommend the material and production method.

02
Get it production-ready

We review your artwork, colour and placement. For a bulk run, agree the sample before moving ahead.

03
Make. Check. Finish.

The production team prints or stitches your design, inspects the output and prepares the finished product.

04
On its way

Products are packed and handed to shipping partners, with tracking through the fulfillment process.

04 / 04Laser cutting & engravingMaterial & applicationWood, acrylic, leather or fabric confirmed as suitable by the team.Before productionProvide material type, thickness and cutting paths. Confirm the finish on a sample before approving the run.
